sehemu: Part I: Commission for Human Rights and Good Governance
jina: Commission for Human Rights and Good Governance
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Commission to be known as the Commission for Human Rights and Good Governance whose functions shall be as provided in Article 130 of this Constitution. (2) The Commission shall consist of the following Commissioners: (a) a Chairman, who shall be a person qualified for appointment as a Judge; (b) a Vice-Chairman, appointed on the principle that where the Chairman comes from one part of the United Republic, the Vice-Chairman shall come from the other part; (c) not more than five other Commissioners appointed from among persons with knowledge, experience and broad understanding of human rights, law, administration, politics or social affairs; and (d) Assistant Commissioners. (3) All Commissioners and Assistant Commissioners shall be appointed by the President after consultation with the Nominations Committee. (4) There shall be a Nominations Committee for purposes of this Article consisting of: (a) the Chief Justice of the Court of Appeal; (b) the Speaker of the National Assembly; (c) the Chief Justice of Zanzibar; (d) the Speaker of the House of Representatives; and (e) the Deputy Attorney General, who shall be Secretary to the Committee. (5) The Chairman, Vice-Chairman and every other Commissioner shall each hold office for three years and may be reappointed for one further term of three years only. (6) For the purpose of protecting Commissioners from conflicts of interest, a person appointed a Commissioner shall immediately relinquish any office in a political party or any other office prescribed by a law enacted by Parliament. (7) A Commissioner or Assistant Commissioner may be removed from office only for inability to perform his functions, whether arising from illness or any other cause, or for misconduct affecting the ethics of the office of Commissioner. (8) The Commission may conduct its business notwithstanding a vacancy among its members or the absence of any member.
